protocol.statistical_seed_role: Resampling only; never changes observation values
protocol.primary_unit: Geometry cluster / recorded CSV, not individual overlapping frames
protocol.fdr_method: Benjamini-Yekutieli across all valid inferential p-values
protocol.derived_columns_rule: Only complete-count rows: one-to-one minimum total circular error; preserve any existing tied optimum. Partial-count native rows keep derived cells empty.
protocol.binary_runs_calibration: Exact conditional distribution, two-sided distance from expectation
protocol.nominal_KW_family: Reported separately with BY correction; not valid inference for repeated geometries

excluded.role: Historical archive/report; excluded from active sample totals
